search_text: published ZDI-19-825 ZDI-CAN-8556 Delta Industrial Automation TPEditor TPE File Parsing Heap-based Buffer Overflow Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2019-09-11 CVE-2019-13536 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2019-13536 7.8 AV:L/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['Delta Industrial Automation'] ['TPEditor'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Delta Industrial Automation TPEditor. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file. The specific flaw exists within the parsing of TPE files. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of the length of user-supplied data prior to copying it to a heap-based buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the current user. Delta Industrial Automation has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. title: Delta Industrial Automation TPEditor TPE File Parsing Heap-based Buffer Overflow Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Delta Industrial Automation TPEditor. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file. The specific flaw exists within the parsing of TPE files. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of the length of user-supplied data prior to copying it to a heap-based buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the current user.
